Subject: 6 Monthly Report

MASSEY UNIVERSITY 

DOCTORAL RESEARCH COMMITTEE

DOCTORAL CANDIDATE REPORT - Six Monthly Progress Report Cover Sheet

Candidates Name: Mr Tony Andrew Meyer 	              

Academic Unit: Institute of Information & Mathematical Science 

Programme:  PhD(Sc)

Provisional Registration Date : 20/09/2002 	         

Registration:  Full Registration 

Submission Date: 21/12/2007  	

Thesis Title: " Computer-Actors. "

Supervisor(s):  
Dr Christopher Hugh Messom
Dr Martin James Johnson


INSTRUCTIONS: (Please read carefully)

CANDIDATE:

1.  Candidates should save the attached Word document.  A PDF version has
also been attached in case you have difficulties opening the Word document.
This form can also be downloaded from the Graduate Research School website.

2.  Candidates should complete Part 1. Answers to questions 9 - 11 should
be kept brief (up to 250 words). 

3.  Please ensure you write your name and Student ID Number in the
allocated space on page 1 of the report.

4.  Candidates should then forward a copy of this email cover sheet and the
report to their supervisor.

SUPERVISORS:

5. Supervisor and co-supervisors to complete Part 2.

6.  Supervisors should then obtain all signatures including the candidate's
and co-supervisor(s) in Part 3.

7.  Once all signatures have been obtained, the Supervisor should photocopy
the report twice, retain one copy and forward the second copy to the
candidate.

8.  The Supervisor should then forward this email cover sheet and the
original report to the Head of Academic Unit.

HEAD OF ACADEMIC UNIT:

9.  The Head of Academic Unit should complete Part 3, read the report and
act on any problems outlined within the body of the report. 

10.  The Head of Academic Unit should sign and photocopy this email cover
sheet and the report, retain the photocopy for their record and forward the
original to the Graduate Research School (PN 713).


Thank you!
